entries.27d2fad6ff611379: This business manufactures and sells reels, rods and fishing gear. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue from external customers was ¥110,832 million (up 5.6% year on year). Manufacturing is carried out by the company, its subsidiaries in Malaysia and China (Kunshan), Shimano Kumamoto Co., Ltd. and others, and sales are carried out by the company and its sales subsidiaries in Europe and North America, among others. Sales were firm, centered on overseas markets, and the spinning reel “STELLA SW” and baitcasting reel “ANTARES” were well received.
entries.4c00cc9a6cfc3b12: A company that makes bicycle components such as gear shifters and brakes, as well as fishing reels and rods, and sells them worldwide.
entries.8a1aedd8a6bfb09a: This business manufactures and sells rowing (boat racing) related products and others. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue from external customers was ¥439 million (down 2.3% year on year), a small share of consolidated revenue. Manufacturing is carried out by the company and its Chinese consolidated subsidiary Shimano (Lianyungang) Industrial Co., Ltd., and sales are mainly carried out by the company.
